about: One row per data load that changed what the public site shows, newest first. Feeds the 'new data' bubble on the map (index.html loadIngestLog). Append with build/log_ingest.py after every load; 'date' is the day the data went live on the site. Numbers come from the load itself or the records-request tracker, never estimates. Started 2026-09-23 with that week's loads only; earlier loads are in git history and data/records_requests.json.

kinds.applications: New pesticide-use rows on the map
kinds.names: Operator names from a county roster
kinds.fix: A correction or filled-in field on rows already on the map

loads.source: State Water Board, Division of Drinking Water (EDT Library, PRA ID #638)
loads.summary: State drinking-water compliance results 2019-2026: 15,037 results for 184 Plumas public water systems. Glyphosate was tested 14 times at one system (Plumas Eureka CSD), all non-detect; no forestry herbicide was ever tested anywhere in the county.
641 permits from the county's 2020-2026 roster. Mapped applications with a named operator went from 8% to 91% (32,132 of 35,230).
Application type filled in for the 481 county-reported 2025-2026 events: 464 ground, 14 aerial, 3 other.
25,062 Placer and Nevada 2022 application rows that were missing from the map. Many lack a PLSS section, so not all become map dots. Operator names still need the county rosters (requested Sep 21).
15,829 county-reported application rows for 2024-2026 (6,773 / 5,384 / 3,672), plus operator names from the county's 414-permit roster.
158 permittees from the county's monthly summary. Mapped applications with a named operator went from 34.5% to 61.9% (9,056 of 14,632).
County permit roster. Mapped applications with a named operator went from 63.4% to 99.9% (151,318 of 151,501).
